Why TIMB Pilger Mills?
  • Servo-controlled feeding & rotation with step-less adjustment for precision accuracy
  • Dual strand machine — two tubes reduced simultaneously for higher output
  • High reduction per pass with superior dimensional accuracy — OD & wall tolerance of ±0.03mm
  • Excellent surface finish and enhanced mechanical properties vs conventional drawing
  • Suitable for difficult-to-work materials — stainless steel, nickel, titanium & alloys
  • High material utilisation with consistent, repeatable tube quality
  • Servo-controlled mandrel rotation for enhanced process control
  • Engineered for critical, high-value tube applications
How Pilger Rolling Works
Reciprocating rolls, incremental feed & rotation
  • A reciprocating roll cassette moves back and forth over tapered die grooves, progressively reducing diameter & wall thickness
  • The tube is incrementally rotated and fed forward between strokes for uniform, all-around reduction
  • Precision guide rails keep the roll carriage tracking accurately at up to 160 strokes per minute
  • Result: superior roundness, surface finish & material grain structure vs conventional drawing
